reviews.text:
I stopped by because my dog ​​has an inflamed eye. The vet performed a quick test to see if the eye itself was also damaged.

After the test, the vet said: "Oh look, that's positive." He delivered it quite cheerfully, and I had to ask myself if it was positive news, or if the test was positive. It turned out the test result was positive. It would be better to start a sentence like that with the word "unfortunately."

I was given three small tubes of drops to take home. They asked me to pay €212. I later found these online for a third of the price. A real rip-off.

They were kind to my dog ​​and very hospitable, but the communication could be better.
It'll probably be fine
I bring my cat here since we moved to Amsterdam, they are very nice and caring. Everyone speaks perfect English which makes things easier for foreigners

I've been taking my cat here for 3 years now, and I'm very happy. They have great facilities, friendly staff, and offer many useful services. Recommend!

Edit: 2 years later and still just as happy.

I used to be very happy with this veterinary clinic. In fact, I was willing to travel more than an hour just to have my dog examined here. The staff had always been polite and professional, which is why this recent experience was so disappointing.

We recently visited the Westerpark location and were not satisfied with the service provided by the veterinarian. Unfortunately, she did not inspire confidence in her knowledge or assessment of the situation. My dog was seen there six days ago for an eye issue. Since then, we have been applying eye drops every hour as instructed, yet we have seen no improvement.

Starting Monday, I tried to schedule an appointment with an eye specialist, but the earliest available slot was in 20 days. The reason I am writing this review here, even though my complaint involves two other clinics, is because the hospital advised that the veterinarian could call the specialist clinic directly to emphasize the urgency and help secure an earlier appointment. I was reassured that I would receive a call by the end of the day confirming this, but that call never came.

I am sorry to say that this is not professional behavior. When it comes to veterinary care, trust is essential, and this experience seriously undermined that trust.

Additionally, the clinic’s availability is extremely limited. Being open only during standard working hours and only four days per week makes it very difficult for clients to access care when it is actually needed.

Considering that appointments cost around €80 for a 20-minute consultation, I would expect a higher level of service, communication, and support when dealing with potentially urgent medical situations.

We've been repeatedly shocked by the poor quality of the veterinary knowledge and their policies here. This review is very overdue.

My cat was dying (I suspected it but didn't know what the problem was, it was a sudden onset of extreme difficulty breathing and walking) and their advice was that I admit him for them to monitor him for 24hrs. I asked if there was anything they could do for him or any testing they would do and they confirmed there wasn't. They didn't recommend I take him to the Emergency vet for testing. They only wanted his last hours to be in a cage in their clinic, away from us, so they could bill us. I said I would prefer he is comfortable with us at this time, rather then stressed in a cage, if there was nothing they could do for him and the person on the phone agreed with me that this was better. Even though she had just given me the "we advise you to bring him to us for monitoring" pitch. I find this so unethical. I spoke with another veterinary practice on the phone, described what was happening, and they told me to take my cat directly to the emergency hospital for an ultrasound. I did this and they immediately found that my cat's heart was failing, it was filling with liquid, that he was in severe pain. With this knowledge we chose for them to drain the liquid to give him some temporary relief, bring him home to say goodbye and euthanize him. If I had followed Dierenkliniek Amsterdam's advice he would have been suffering in a cage for an extra day, away from us. This idea breaks my heart and outrages me.

After this incident I continued to bring my dog to them for routine vaccines and her monthly librela injection because their prices were better than Dierenkliniek Vondelpark. But I switched over to Dierenkliniek Vondelpark for all consultations and actual medical advice for my other cat and my senior dog.

Fast forward to 2 years later, my dog has a sudden mysterious skin infection that I can feel is spreading very rapidly under her coat. She's a husky with an extremely dense undercoat. I'm away all day and my father brings her in to the clinic because she happened to already have an appointment for her monthly Librela injection. The vet takes one look and gives him a lotion to "spread on it." I had given him explicit instructions to explain that I could feel it spreading through the skin in areas that were not visible. (the central infection was visible where hair had fallen out in a small area (the size of a small coin) only). He told them this. It was ignored. They did not shave her. They gave a lotion to spread on a fraction of an accessible hot spot for a husky. Lotion cannot reach the skin of a husky without shaving. There is no logical way to spread lotion on the skin of a dog like a husky without shaving. The idea requires a complete lack of thought process. You also cannot see the extent of the infection without shaving. My father returned home and explained what happened. I immediately called Dierenkliniek Vondelpark for an appointment the next day. They shaved her and found the infection to be HUGE. They agreed the lotion would never have worked without shaving. It required 3x daily cleansing spray and lotion application to the entire area to clear the infection over a week. If I had just followed this clinic's advice it would have spread so aggressively within days.

I also had senior blood work done with them in the past which showed elevated liver levels for my senior dog. They told me this was because her teeth needed a cleaning. I got advice from Dierenkliniek Vondelpark and started her on liver supplements which have dramatically improved her liver values without running me up a huge bill on a teeth cleaning for a 13 year old dog (who they shouldn't be recommending for anesthesia anyway).

I really recommend you find a clinic with more attentive, thoughtful vets and with less of a money-making culture. I cannot say they put the wellbeing of your animal ahead of their profits.
They're now part of Evidensia, so they only do it for the money. They're too expensive now, they do unnecessary research, and you're better off looking for an independent vet!

I'm so happy with the service I receive here. The vets were super attentive and made sure to address all my concerns. They clearly love animals and took great care of my furry friend. I feel comfortable and confident in their expertise throughout the entire appointment.

Excellent doctors, they're gentle with the animals and take their time.
Excellent care.

I have been bringing my cats here for 3 years. In the last year we came almost every 2-3 months because of several reasons and each time I asked them if anything else was due, any shots/vaccinations etc. They always said no. A week ago I noticed that my cats’ rabies vaccinations have actually expired by 5 months now even though they always said no. I called to make an appointment and asked them to at least cover the costs of renewing the titration tests for traveling abroad since they also have become invalid because of this gap that occurred due to their fault. It’s already bad enough that my babies and I have to go through this whole process again. They said they were going to check this with their manager. 1 week after I came to my appointment and this was still not checked. They expect me to spend even more money at a place that caused this without even knowing if it will be covered. After such mistake they don’t even show the courtesy of handling such a simple request on a timely manner or at least inform me before my appointment that it was not discussed yet. I always came here and spent so much money on all the treatments of my cats for years and the result is this. Will change vets and start working with a more professional place.
Great vets and staff. Nice examination space. The only negative is that anything more involved has to be done at their farther, lesser location.

We brought our rabbit in for a check-up. Unfortunately, a few weeks later it turned out he was sick. When we contacted them again, we were told that the clinic actually doesn't have enough knowledge of rabbits and that we would be better off going to a branch in IJburg. It is a shame this wasn't indicated earlier – this could possibly have prevented problems. The IJburg branch didn't know what it was either, and we eventually ended up at the Vondelpark location. Fortunately, our little rabbit is still alive, but it was a long and difficult road.
Always friendly and helpful 👍🏻 …

In fact, at the beginning when the clinic opened I was not happy with the organization that prevailed there.
But after a few years I can definitely give 5 stars. It is a pity that there is not one permanent vet , often there are others.  Assistant vet Rianne is amazing . 🥰Energetic, communicative, helpful and very friendly.(we love you together with Neli ).Nice to come back to such clinics.😊

Initially, a nice clinic thought along with me and gave me some pointers, but lately this became less pleasant. The visits with our cats one of our cats had an extra cap over its nail and the vet seemed uncertain while clipping and gave the impression of being afraid to clip that nail, which I already found difficult to see. From that moment on, it became more and more of these little things. At the last consultation, I also went for vaccinations and was told that my first cat of the two I had with me was suffering from cavities, but that was not clear to me at first because the vet had an accent so I kept understanding what she meant, even after asking for an explanation several times. I also asked, "Is it not bothering him and should I do something about it?" She said that he was not bothered by it and I did not have to do anything about it immediately, even though he had a bloody bag on his tooth which worried me. She still stuck with her answer, so I left it as it was and the second one was put on the table and immediately upon listening to the heart, she noticed a slight I knew I could expect medication with a heart murmur. I'd experienced it before, so my tension rose. Unfortunately, she told me not to worry for now because it was barely audible. I replied that I would have appreciated it if she could still develop a long-term plan of action, but that wasn't necessary. Unfortunately, my distrust only grew. After this consultation, I decided to go to a different clinic. At the current clinic, I also mentioned these problems with the cats, and they advised getting x-rays of one of the cats' teeth. Then we could see what to do. I had that done, and what I feared happened. He had cavities, and the pocket on his tooth was severely infected. That tooth had to be removed asap. Then you're told afterwards that another tooth is not well, and he's in real pain. So I was saddled with a feeling of guilt because I almost followed the advice. This clinic listened and I am therefore quite angry with the person who helped me at the time because this should have been said that this was not right. I hope I will continue to have positive experiences with my current clinic.
The doctors are very attentive, all the staff is nice.

I’ve only had very good experiences at this animal hospital. They are kind and compassionate. Myy dog alice b is a bit bitey and needs a muzzle bc she’s a tough patient, but she is comforted by the kind people who work here.
Kind and helpful staff

The staff is fantastic—super friendly and always eager to help. The vets are professional and patient with my nervous dog during every visit. They have multiple clinics across Amsterdam, which is a nice plus.

Beyond grateful to call this place my dog’s vet. The stuff are lovely, the service is excellent, and they are always helpful. They explain everything with patience and treat the animals fantastically. Deeple recommend this place
I took Oscar and received lovely help . girls are so helpful and kind.
